notes.title: The new game by the creator of Milky Way Prince is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103680/Mediterranea_Inferno/

It's here! The long awaited new game from the author of Milky Way Prince is another mature and treacherous visual novel. In it, you explore the inner demons of three young men on a post-pandemic summer retreat. [i]Unearth secrets, fears and obsessions as you help them reconnect and rediscover themselves![/i]

I'm very happy to have had the chance to work on this project, I think Lorenzo really outdid himself this time, creating a work that as visually captivating as it is poignant.

The team and I are looking forward to hearing what you think of it, and reviews on Steam really do help us reach a wider audience so remember to leave one after you finish Mediterranea Inferno!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34152/Mediterranea_Inferno_Game__Soundtrack_Bundle/
[b]
The game is available with a 10% discount for the first week ($13.49) and a 25% discount if you get the soundtrack bundle. Speaking of which, it's an incredible 60+ minutes of bliss, and if you don't believe me you can preview it on [url=https://santaragione.bandcamp.com/album/mediterranea-inferno-original-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url].[/b]

Thank you as always for your support! 

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Summer holiday turns treacherous in horror visual novel Mediterranea Inferno, out today
notes.content:
Even cursed years such as 2020 can occasionally hide small nuggets of greatness. One such nugget was the curious visual novel Milky Way Prince, which beautifully mixed surreal 2D images with even more surreal 3D backgrounds, all wrapped up in a toxic love story. Just when you thought a visual novel couldn’t get any more stylish, developer Lorenzo “Eyeguys” Redaelli comes back to one-up themself with Mediterranea Inferno, a rare game that makes you want to gobble its colours up with your eyeballs. Oh, and it’s out right now.

Read more

notes.title: Mediterranea Inferno - a new game from the creator of Milky Way Prince
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103680/Mediterranea_Inferno/

Dear friends,

We're excited to share some thrilling news with you today! We have a new game coming later this year - Mediterranea Inferno, a visual novel drama that is quite unlike anything you've played before.

Picture this: A tranquil summer retreat in Italy suddenly spiraling into an eerie mystery. Mediterranea Inferno offers a deep dive into the enigmatic world of three childhood friends who reunite after the isolating 2020 pandemic.

Uncover secrets, confront fears, and navigate obsessions as you traverse through this intense visual novel. The narrative presents a compelling exploration of friendship, desire, and grief, all through the lenses of three antiheroes.

To make sure you don't miss out, you can wishlist Mediterranea Inferno on Steam starting today!

[previewyoutube=_TwHP78G4Jg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A Unique Creation by Lorenzo Redaelli[/b]

This game is another brainchild of Lorenzo Redaelli, the critically acclaimed creator behind Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star! Once again, Redaelli is not only the writer and director, but also the artist and composer behind this latest venture.

[b]Get A Glimpse Soon[/b]

Can't wait to jump into this treacherous vacation? Well, you won't have to wait long. We're delighted to announce that a demo of Mediterranea Inferno will be available for the upcoming June Steam Next Fest. 

[b]Coming Later This Year[/b]

Mediterranea Inferno is set to make its debut later this year. We're excited to see the game come to life, and even more so, to hear what you think about it!

Until next time,

Pietro and the SR Team

notes.title: Saturnalia - our new game, coming soon and ready to wishlist!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/Saturnalia/

Dear friends,

We hope you're doing well! We have some news to share with you that we think you'll be excited about. Our third-person survival horror adventure, Saturnalia, will be launching on Steam later this year!

What's the game about? It's a single-player third-person survival horror adventure where you play as four characters, experiencing an intergenerational storyline tied to the haunting traditions of an ancient village in Sardinia, Italy, a region rich with unique folklore… 

Chek out this in-depth gameplay trailer to learn more about the game mechanics!

[previewyoutube=OGHYSwMyeAM;full]: [previewyoutube=Wu-dLkGwZd4;full]https://youtu.be/Wu-dLkGwZd4[/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

To make sure you don't miss out on the action, you can wishlist Saturnalia on Steam starting today.

We can't wait for you to join us on this thrilling adventure! As always, thank you for your support, and we'll keep you updated on the latest news about Saturnalia's release.

Happy gaming!

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: The best game you missed in August 2020: Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star
notes.content:
As 2020 goes kicking and screaming into that good night, we’ve rounded up some of the best games from the year that we didn’t end up covering. Check the Best Game You Missed tag for more.

Playing Milky Way Prince made me think about people I would rather forget, and memories that will never quite stop hurting. You know, the ones about the intense, dysfunctional relationships you sometimes end up in when you’re stupid and young.

It’s a game that feels young at its core – the first commercial work of a solo developer, Lorenzo “eyeguys” Redaelli, and the first work published by developer Santa Ragione, of Wheels Of Aurelia fame. Like many young adults, it’s rough around the edges and entirely too sincere.

(more…)

notes.title: Milky Way Prince – Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=x-TmSgSAX8U;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302050/Milky_Way_Prince__The_Vampire_Star/

During Gamescom 2020, as part of the Indie Arena Booth, play the first chapter and a half, and continue where you left off in the full game!

In this visual novel, you'll live a summer of dysfunctional love through branching storylines, twists, sudden changes, and a special mechanic where you choose which senses to use with your boyfriend. In these moments, you will learn about him, his personality, and his past, making you question everything.

Milky Way Prince is a semi-autobiographical story entirely designed, programmed, illustrated, and scored by a young author, Lorenzo Redaelli. We can't wait for you to tell us what you think.

Thank you as always,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=x-TmSgSAX8U;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302100/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302050/Milky_Way_Prince__The_Vampire_Star/

[b]DEMO AVAILABLE ONLY FOR THE DURATION OF GAMESCOM 2020[/b]

Milky Way Prince follows a budding, dysfunctional relationship between two young men. Following a chance encounter, the starry-eyed Nuki falls head over heels for Sune, a brooding and mysterious character seemingly ripped from the pages of Nuki’s favorite childhood story. The ensuing dalliance isn’t without its problems, though, as it spawns an emotional whirlwind fueled by the couple’s intense psychological demons and complicated histories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943247/76e9a36e33bce9faca6ea3eaf679e02ac582f79c.gif[/img]

During the star-crossed lovers’ intimate encounters, Nuki can focus on his senses to guide the experience and learn more about his troubled boyfriend. Contend with discoveries about the fabled man of Nuki’s dreams while grappling with issues including idealization, submission, boundaries, and self-worth. Every decision has consequences and will coalesce to reveal hidden truths and diverge the story down branching paths leading to multiple endings. 

Milky Way Prince is a semi-autobiographical tale that draws inspiration from a tumultuous romance. With art, code, music, and dialogue by Lorenzo Redaelli, this is the first project published by us, as we start distributing independent games from talented Italian creators that share the spirit of our own experimental works.

[b]HIGHLIGHTS[/b]

[list]
[*]     Semi-autobiographical dark romance story
[*]     Branching narrative paths with multiple endings
[*]     Intimate new sensory gameplay system
[*]     Character art inspired by Suehiro Maruo and Masaaki Yuasa
[*]     3D environments influenced by the stage design of Robert Wilson
[*]     30+ minutes of baroque electropop original soundtrack
[/list]
